scope: Historical per-query application-level search costs, exactly once per sequence/attempt; no new measurement.
transformation: Select every original search_costs_counted_once row, adding only its external round and archived profile identity. Preserve all retained numeric values and types; no raw query text or private execution paths included.
limitations: Stage durations are inclusive diagnostics; do not add them to define end-to-end query latency.

Do not add duplicate terminal-event snapshots to these already deduplicated rows.
Source-reference/import/journal I/O is outside this trace scope.
Cost rows retain the old implementation/input/protocol identity, not current binary measurements.
